summary: Fresh isolated Chrome session at the assigned product route verified HTTP 200, one product root, five tabs, review and download tab activation, direct #reviews activation, description expansion, inquiry open/close, and native variation selection without form submission or POST requests. Runtime emitted no page or console errors. Two state/accessibility defects remain.
issues: INT-PRODUCT-01 (high, state identity): expected the tabs-content data-factory-section identity to be cleared or updated when leaving the downloads state; actual value remains product-files after the description panel becomes the sole active panel. Fix tab activation so every state deterministically resets and then assigns the correct section identity.

INT-PRODUCT-02 (medium, keyboard tabs): expected ArrowRight on the ARIA tablist to move focus/selection to the next tab; actual focus remains technical and selected tab remains reviews. Implement standard tablist arrow-key handling while retaining click and hash behavior.
